main_measure.name: t of mean forecast/10 x excess 2-bar return over Sunday cases, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with the check passing; reject if t <= -2; at least 100 cases with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: top third minus bottom third mean excess 2-bar return

decided_by: The main t is between -2 and 2.
reading: Cases are bars with regime 'trending' and forecast > 0 whose t+2 close lies in the same window; thirds are n//3 cases each, ranked by forecast; the plan's 'fewer than 100 cases' is treated as the minimum count (not observable); the situation check identifies days from the UTC start timestamp.
